title: Organisation structure
subtitle: Branches, departments, designations and teams. Archived rows stay for history and can be reactivated.

fields.countryCodeHint: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. OM, AE, SA

branches.dialogHint: Devices and employees are attached to a branch; its timezone drives attendance dates.
branches.archiveHint: Archived branches are hidden from pickers. Branches with active employees cannot be archived — move the employees first.
branches.emptyHint: Create your first branch to start adding employees and devices.
branches.inheritWeeklyOffHint: Turn off to set branch-specific off days.
branches.noCalendars: No holiday calendars are configured yet. Create one under Holidays to assign it here.

departments.dialogHint: Departments can be nested and optionally limited to one branch.
departments.archiveHint: Departments with sub-departments or assigned employees cannot be archived.
departments.emptyHint: Departments group employees for reports and shift assignment.
departments.branchHint: Leave empty for a department shared across branches.

designations.archiveHint: Designations assigned to employees cannot be archived.
designations.emptyHint: Designations are job titles (e.g. Cashier, Supervisor) used in reports.

teams.dialogHint: Teams are flexible groups for shift assignment and reporting; a member can be in several teams.
teams.archiveHint: Archiving a team removes its members from the team. Attendance history is not affected.
teams.emptyHint: Create teams to assign shifts to a group of employees at once.
teams.membersHint: Search and pick employees; the list replaces the current membership on save.
